why: The cloned repo (LeonardoArrighi/DPG, v0.3.2) is the authors' general Decision Predicate Graph framework and it is healthy: Python 3.10-3.12, sklearn>=1.5, numpy 2.x, networkx, no dead frameworks, 42 py files, full test suite. But the paper's specific machinery — Isolation Forest DPG construction, class-weighted edges and the Inlier-Outlier Propagation Score (Eq. 2) — does not appear anywhere in the inspected tree or imports (no 'IOP' symbol, no iForest explainer; dpg/explainer.py only covers RandomForest/GB/AdaBoost/ExtraTree style ensembles), and the second cited repo (Math0097/DPG-iForest) was not cloned. Annthyroid and the two synthetic datasets are also absent (only datasets/custom.csv). So: keep the authors' DPG node/edge/predicate logic, rebuild the iForest path-traversal weighting and IOP-Score from the paper, download Annthyroid, and regenerate the synthetic sets from Section 4.1 / Tables 2 and 4.
missing_artifacts: IOP-Score (Eq. 2) implementation and Inlier-Outlier propagation over class-weighted edges — not present in the cloned DPG repo
Isolation Forest -> DPG construction (iForest split rules + training-sample traversals with model-output inlier/outlier labels)
Annthyroid dataset (UCI, 6 numerical features, 6,916 samples, ~3.61% anomalies) — must be downloaded and the binary features dropped
Synthetic dataset 1 generator (200 samples, 6 features, Sample 0 altered in F0/F3/F4/F5 per Table 2)
Synthetic dataset 2 generator (200 samples, 6 features, Samples 0-3 altered per Table 4)
github.com/Math0097/DPG-iForest — the paper's dedicated repo, cited but not included in this inspection
blockers_seen: cloned repo is the general DPG library, not the iForest extension: no iForest explainer, no IOP-Score, no Annthyroid/synthetic experiment scripts

exact predicate-pair (f,sigma) aggregation and edge class-weighting convention of Eq. 2 are only described in prose/tables, so a rebuild may reproduce the ranking (TSH > lowest, TSH <= highest) but not necessarily the 4-decimal values -0.2429 / -0.0282 / 0.0965
repository requires a Graphviz `dot` binary for rendering only (explanation numbers unaffected)

feasibility.est_runtime_on_this_machine: 5-15 minutes of command time: ~3 min pip install (numpy/sklearn/networkx/pandas/matplotlib already pinned and wheel-available for Py3.12), ~1 min Annthyroid download, then a 200-tree IsolationForest fit on 6,916x6 plus full sample traversal and graph build in seconds; the only real cost is 2-3 iterations against Table 6 to pin down the Eq. 2 sign/weighting convention.

compute.basis: 200-tree sklearn IsolationForest on 6,916x6 Annthyroid plus traversal of all samples through the trees and a graph build over ~10^3-10^4 predicate edges is seconds of CPU work; the budget is dominated by dependency install and by rebuilding/validating the IOP-Score formula against Table 6.
